word: Title: Morning At The Plaza
answer: Mañana En La Plaza

word: I speak with a vendor about fruit.
answer: "Hablo con un vendedor sobre fruta."

word: You take a small bag from the table. [sing, inf]
answer: "Tomas una bolsita de la mesa."

word: We work together to choose good mangos.
answer: "Trabajamos juntos para escoger buenos mangos."

word: They eat a few slices while we wait.
answer: "Ellos comen unos pedazos mientras esperamos."

word: I live near this plaza and come often.
answer: "Vivo cerca de esta plaza y vengo seguido."

word: She takes the basket to the counter.
answer: "Ella lleva la canasta al mostrador."

word: He arrives early to open his stand.
answer: "Él llega temprano para abrir su puesto."

word: You call the vendor to ask the price. [sing, inf]
answer: "Llamas al vendedor para preguntar el precio."

word: We listen to the music from the street.
answer: "Escuchamos la música de la calle."

word: They see the fresh fruit on the table.
answer: "Miran la fruta fresca en la mesa."

word: I buy two mangos for breakfast.
answer: "Compro dos mangos para el desayuno."

word: You search for ripe bananas nearby. [sing, inf]
answer: "Buscas plátanos maduros por aquí."

word: We need a little more fruit for home.
answer: "Necesitamos un poco más de fruta para la casa."

word: He asks the vendor for a discount.
answer: "Él pregunta al vendedor por un descuento."

word: They wait patiently in the short line.
answer: "Ellos esperan pacientemente en la fila corta."

word: She changes her mind and picks apples.
answer: "Ella cambia de opinión y elige manzanas."

word: We walk slowly through the plaza.
answer: "Caminamos despacio por la plaza."

word: I pass by the flower stand with joy.
answer: "Paso por el puesto de flores con gusto."

word: You enter the café for a quick drink. [sing, inf]
answer: "Entras al cafecito por una bebida rápida."

word: I must leave soon for my class.
answer: "Debo salir pronto para mi clase."

word: They believe the fruit here is the best.
answer: "Ellos creen que la fruta aquí es la mejor."

word: We learn new recipes from the vendor.
answer: "Aprendemos recetas nuevas del vendedor."

word: She writes the recipe in her notebook.
answer: "Ella escribe la receta en su cuaderno."

word: You travel to this plaza every weekend. [sing, inf]
answer: "Viajas a esta plaza cada fin de semana."

word: We help the vendor carry boxes.
answer: "Ayudamos al vendedor a cargar cajas."

word: I am going to buy more fruit later.
answer: "Voy a comprar más fruta más tarde."

word: They are going to visit another stand.
answer: "Ellos van a visitar otro puesto."

word: We are going to return tomorrow morning.
answer: "Vamos a regresar mañana por la mañana."
